title_zh: 改到第八版后的一句栓Q
title_en: New Slang, New Stories (15/20): "Shuan Q" After the Eighth Draft
note_en: The 把 construction moves the object before the verb so you can say what happens to it: 终于把方案改到了第八版 "finally revised the proposal all the way to its eighth version." English simply says "revise the proposal," but in Chinese a verb with a result or destination like 改到第八版 usually needs 把 to bring the object forward.
